operation.name: GetNonGBVAttachments_ELRP
operation.query: SELECT [NonGBVAttachmentID] ,[NonGBVDetailID] ,[Filename] ,[FileAttached] ,[ContentType] ,[CreationUserID] ,[LastModificationTimestamp] ,[LastModificationUserID] FROM [NonGBVAttachment_ELRP] WHERE [Deleted] = 0 AND [NonGBVDetailID] = @NonGBVDetailID order by [NonGBVAttachmentID] ASC

operation.name: InsertNonGBVAttachment_ELRP
operation.query: SET @ReturnValue = 0; INSERT INTO [NonGBVAttachment_ELRP] ([NonGBVDetailID] ,[Filename] ,[FileAttached] ,[ContentType] ,[CreationUserID] ,[LastModificationTimestamp] ,[LastModificationUserID] ,[Deleted]) VALUES (@NonGBVDetailID ,@Filename ,@FileAttached ,@ContentType ,@CreationUserID ,@LastModificationTimestamp ,@LastModificationUserID ,0); SET @ReturnValue = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

operation.name: UpdateNonGBVAttachment_ELRP
operation.query: IF(NOT EXISTS (SELECT NonGBVAttachmentID FROM NonGBVAttachment_ELRP WHERE DELETED = 0 AND NonGBVAttachmentID = @NonGBVAttachmentID)) SET @ReturnValue = 0; ELSE BEGIN UPDATE [NonGBVAttachment_ELRP] SET [Filename] = @Filename ,[FileAttached] = @FileAttached ,[ContentType] = @ContentType ,[LastModificationTimestamp] = @LastModificationTimestamp ,[LastModificationUserID] = @LastModificationUserID ,[Deleted] = 0 WHERE [Deleted] = 0 and NonGBVAttachmentID = @NonGBVAttachmentID SET @ReturnValue = 1; END

operation.name: DeleteNonGBVAttachment_ELRP
operation.query: IF(NOT EXISTS (SELECT NonGBVAttachmentID FROM NonGBVAttachment_ELRP WHERE DELETED = 0 AND NonGBVAttachmentID = @NonGBVAttachmentID)) SET @ReturnValue = 0; ELSE BEGIN UPDATE [NonGBVAttachment_ELRP] SET [LastModificationTimestamp] = GETDATE() ,[LastModificationUserID] = @UserID ,[Deleted] = 1 WHERE NonGBVAttachmentID = @NonGBVAttachmentID SET @ReturnValue = 1; END
